title: Label Service Common Types
description: Shared types for the label service (docs/labels-v0.md). Additive phase-2 contract of the content-less optimization design: opaque references, key and signature encodings, and the ref-keyed maps the optimization schemas reference. Every definition carries its x-content-class.

SchemaVersion.description: Label contract version. Also the leading envelope version byte.

Purpose.description: What a label names. Bound into the envelope AAD, so a ciphertext cannot be replayed under another purpose.

TenantRef.description: Server-issued opaque reference to a tenant: the tenant id, `tenant_<32 lowercase hex>` as the Backend issues it (`enterprise_tenant.py` default id).

ProjectRef.description: Server-issued opaque reference to a project (the key scope: one key pair per project per epoch): the project id, `project_<32 lowercase hex>` as the Backend issues it (`project.py` default id).

ObjectRef.description: Server-issued opaque reference to the object a label is attached to (a knob, choice, metric, template, dataset, agent, evaluation set or evaluator). The label service never learns what the object is called. Format `<kind>ref_<32 lowercase hex>` (the Backend's server-minted reference convention, `_new_id(prefix)` in pillar_legend_service.py: prefix + `_` + uuid4 hex); the client may not rely on anything else about it. The kind is one of the closed set in the pattern.

KnobRef.description: Server-issued opaque reference to a configuration knob; replaces the customer's knob name. Format `<kind>ref_<32 lowercase hex>` (the Backend's server-minted reference convention, `_new_id(prefix)` in pillar_legend_service.py: prefix + `_` + uuid4 hex); the client may not rely on anything else about it.

ChoiceRef.description: Server-issued opaque reference to one categorical choice of a knob; replaces the customer's choice string. Format `<kind>ref_<32 lowercase hex>` (the Backend's server-minted reference convention, `_new_id(prefix)` in pillar_legend_service.py: prefix + `_` + uuid4 hex); the client may not rely on anything else about it.

MetricRef.description: Server-issued opaque reference to a metric; replaces the customer's metric name. Format `<kind>ref_<32 lowercase hex>` (the Backend's server-minted reference convention, `_new_id(prefix)` in pillar_legend_service.py: prefix + `_` + uuid4 hex); the client may not rely on anything else about it.

AgentRef.description: Server-issued opaque reference to an agent; replaces agent_key / agent_id labels. Format `<kind>ref_<32 lowercase hex>` (the Backend's server-minted reference convention, `_new_id(prefix)` in pillar_legend_service.py: prefix + `_` + uuid4 hex); the client may not rely on anything else about it.

DatasetRef.description: Server-issued opaque reference to an evaluation dataset; replaces dataset_id labels. Format `<kind>ref_<32 lowercase hex>` (the Backend's server-minted reference convention, `_new_id(prefix)` in pillar_legend_service.py: prefix + `_` + uuid4 hex); the client may not rely on anything else about it.

EvaluationSetRef.description: Server-issued opaque reference to an evaluation set; replaces evaluation-set names. Format `<kind>ref_<32 lowercase hex>` (the Backend's server-minted reference convention, `_new_id(prefix)` in pillar_legend_service.py: prefix + `_` + uuid4 hex); the client may not rely on anything else about it.

EvaluatorRef.description: Server-issued opaque reference to an evaluator; replaces evaluator_id labels. Format `<kind>ref_<32 lowercase hex>` (the Backend's server-minted reference convention, `_new_id(prefix)` in pillar_legend_service.py: prefix + `_` + uuid4 hex); the client may not rely on anything else about it.

KeyId.description: First 16 bytes of SHA-256(raw public key), unpadded base64url (22 characters). Derived from the key, not chosen by anyone.
KeyId.x-content-note: derived key identifier, not customer content

PublicKey.description: Raw 32-byte public key (X25519 or Ed25519), unpadded base64url.
PublicKey.x-content-note: public key material, not customer content

Signature.x-content-note: signature over canonical binding bytes, not customer content

Enc.description: HPKE encapsulated key `enc` (32 bytes for DHKEM(X25519)), unpadded base64url.

Salt.description: Random or fixed public salt, unpadded base64url.

Epoch.description: Project key epoch (1-based, fits the 4-byte envelope epoch field). Epoch 0 is reserved for the recovery wrap of the tenant root key.

Revision.description: Object content revision. 0 means the object does not exist yet.

ConfigRefMap.description: A configuration expressed as knob_ref -> choice_ref | number | boolean. Replaces a config keyed by customer knob names. Keys and categorical values are opaque references; the customer-side token map lives in the label service as ciphertext.

MetricValueMap.description: Metric values keyed by metric_ref. Replaces a metrics map keyed by customer metric names.

ChoiceRefMap.description: knob_ref -> the choice_refs declared for that knob (categorical choices).
